welcome-email.action: async (instance) => { const { username, email } = instance.context; console.log(`[Workflow] 正在发送欢迎邮件给 ${username} (${email})`); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000)); console.log(`[Workflow] 欢迎邮件已发送`); return { emailSent: true }; }

init-user-workspace.action: async (instance) => { const { userId } = instance.context; console.log(`[Workflow] 正在初始化企业级工作区 for ${userId}`); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); return { workspaceId: 'ws-' + userId }; }

complete-audit.action: async (instance) => { const idpUsers = typeof instance.state.nodes['notify-idp-status']?.output?.data === 'string' ? JSON.parse(instance.state.nodes['notify-idp-status'].output.data) : instance.state.nodes['notify-idp-status']?.output?.data; console.log(`[Workflow] IDP Center 用户数据查询完成，当前系统共有 ${idpUsers?.length || 0} 名用户`); console.log(`[Workflow] 注册后续流程处理完毕`); return { success: true }; }
